'''Shauz Farr''' was a [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Commander/Legends|commander]] of the group of disenfranchised Mandalorians known as the [[Hidden Chain]] who opposed [[Mandalore the Avenger]] during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Biography==
{{Quote|And now you're trying to take Rik'an down with you!''"<br />"''Rik'an is better than this. Better than you!|Shauz Farr and Sa'har Kateen.|<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />}}
Around [[3622 BBY]],<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.9}}</ref> the [[Eternal Alliance]] launched [[Battle of Khar Shian|an attack]] on the Hidden Chain's base on Khar Shian, after Heta Kol allied herself with [[Darth Jadus]] and build the full-scale version of [[Darth Nul]]'s machine. When [[Sa'har Kateen]] and her brother [[Ri'kan Kateen|Rik'an]] escaped their captivity, Shauz Farr chased them down to the entrance of the base, enraged over their betrayal. However, he was met with the Alliance's task force, with [[Alliance Commander]], [[Lana Beniko]] and [[Theron Shan]] backing the [[Twi'lek]] twins. After a short duel, Farr was brought down to his knees and Beniko promptly sliced him with her lighstaber, ending the Mandalorian's life.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />

==Behind the scenes==
Shauz Farr first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'', as part of "Game Update 7.9: Legacy Reborn," released on [[June 2]], [[2026]].<ref name="7.9">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20260602-0|text=Game Update 7.9 "Legacy Reborn" is live!}}</ref>

Depending on the player character's choice, Sa'har is either accompanying them or not. That changes the dialogues during the fight with Farr.<ref name="Legacy Reborn" />
